methods.name: PANDA (unsuPervised shAllow laNdslide rapiD mApping)
methods.summary: A two-phase GIS-based methodology for shallow landslide mapping. It uses NDVI variations from Sentinel-2 imagery combined with geomorphological filters (slope) and hydrographic network masking to identify potential landslides, with an improved post-emergency phase incorporating land-use change filters and higher-resolution DTMs.
methods.verbatim: In this work, we introduce the two-phase methodology “PANDA”, the unsuPervised shAllow laNdslide rapiD mApping... Data are available at the link https://zenodo.org/records/10706716.

availability.author_statement: Data availability statement present with shared links.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are referenced and publicly accessible via the provided links. However, the custom PANDA methodology code is not available in the provided repository or documentation.
